resources.string: KidEase uses your location only while you search so we can show licensed daycares near you. Location is not used in the background.
KidEase uses the camera for video calls with a daycare. The camera stays off until you join a call.
KidEase uses the microphone for voice and video calls with a daycare. The microphone stays off until you join a call.
KidEase sends a notification when a daycare messages you or when a call comes in.
